title: Roles and Permissions Reference

roles.notes: Can handle assigned inquiries and add internal notes.
Can bulk reassign inquiries, approve macros, and view queue reports.
Can configure queues, business hours, roles, and integrations.
Can inspect conversations and reports but cannot change inquiry state.

permission_notes: Only Support Admins can rotate API keys.
Only Team Leads and Support Admins can reopen resolved conversations in bulk.
Exports include redaction by default for tokens, emails, and phone-like strings.
